occlusionContract: Foreground hip pin centers are visibly solid; true insertion depth behind chassis armor is unknown.
Upper outer body bosses are visible but their rear-leg ownership is inferred, not anatomy proof. Parent layout analysis must decide mapping and behind-body ordering.
Render candidate rear links behind the chassis; front links may cover its lower side armor while body pin caps and front optics remain consistent. Exact overlap/z order is not yet approved.
The closed belly spout and two folded calibration manipulators remain body pixels; never count them as drive legs or clip them away as leg cutouts.
All shared parts have one painted front/top lighting direction. Rotate display instances honestly; avoid treating rotated highlights or absent far surfaces as new art.
Keep piston source at one length while evaluating fixed-length two-link IK. Uniform stretching would alter barrel/rod/caps and is not mechanically authored telescoping.
Foot has one projected sole. A lifted/tilted pad could expose an unauthored underside; no mask/warp was made to fake it.

parentRigMath.pinAlignment: For each fragment use the crop-local proximal joint as pivot. Align it to parent projected hip/knee with rotation atan2(targetDeltaY,targetDeltaX)-sourceAxis.angleRadians. Length/scale are a parent layout decision, not fixed by this sheet.
parentRigMath.footAlignment: Use ankle crop point for foot pivot. Approximate sole point is a ground-reference hint, not a foot-lock implementation.
parentRigMath.affineDisplayOnly: Source PNG remains untouched; no component extraction/export PNGs or pixel masks are supplied.

manualMarkerReview: Preserved PNG and independent SVG display with manual pin/axis overlays opened directly. Markers lie in solid visible gold pin caps; axis vectors are projected attachment-center lines, not proof of3D anatomy.
